items.label: About section: the description
items.value: I’m Shivam Parmar, and Shivo Labs is my freelance software and digital solutions business in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania. I design and build websites, [[iPhone, Android and Windows apps]], and [[custom systems*]] such as task and document management, dashboards and internal tools. I set up AI workflows and automation, including [[MCP connections]] that let AI agents work with your own systems, saving you time. I also do branding, photography and social media for businesses in Tanzania, East Africa and beyond.

items.label: The opening description
items.value: I run Shivo Labs, my freelance software and digital solutions business in Dar es Salaam. I design and build [[websites, apps and custom systems]] for businesses, and set up the [[AI workflows]] that run inside them: [[functional at their core and considered in every detail]].

items.label: What I believe (next to the numbers)
items.value: I believe the most lasting work pairs [[technical precision with emotional depth]]. It creates systems that [[resonate with the people they serve]], from customers to teams and communities, and builds strong connections and [[long-term growth]] in business and in life.

items.label: Websites and apps: the opening paragraph
items.value: A website is often the first thing a customer sees of your business. Shivo Labs designs and builds websites and web apps in Dar es Salaam that load fast on any phone and any network, read well in English and Kiswahili, and are set up to be found on Google and in AI assistants like ChatGPT and Claude.

items.value: Custom software and business systems

items.label: Custom software and business systems: the short line
items.value: Business systems built around how your company works: tasks, files, permits, stock and reports in one place.

items.label: Custom software and business systems: the opening paragraph
items.value: Spreadsheets and WhatsApp groups only go so far. Shivo Labs builds custom systems around how your company actually works: tasks, files, approvals, permits and reports in one place, for one company or a whole group of companies. Built in Tanzania, for the way work is done here.

items.label: AI workflows and automation: the name
items.value: AI workflows and automation

items.label: AI workflows and automation: the short line
items.value: AI and automation that save your team hours every week: reports, replies, data entry and documents done for you.

items.label: AI workflows and automation: the opening paragraph
items.value: Much of the work in an office repeats every day: copying data, writing the same replies, preparing the same reports. Shivo Labs designs AI workflows with tools like Claude and builds automations into your everyday work, so the repetitive part happens by itself and your people spend their time where it matters.

items.label: Branding, content and social media: the opening paragraph
items.value: People judge a brand in seconds, on a phone screen. Shivo Labs creates the look and the content that make a business recognisable: logos and brand identity, photography, posters, and social media posts planned month by month, for brands in Tanzania and beyond.
